week_focus: This is the assessing week. Retrieve the actual pouch, design and records. Finish safely, secure loose ends, trim only with agreed scissors and account for all needles. Only after clearance, test three actual 60mm by 80mm paper cards: fit without force, hold upright and lift gently, then check joins and handling. Never test adhesive before its full label-specified cure. Evaluate against the actual purpose, keep the pupil’s own judgement and one improvement, and record support or unfinished work honestly. The Evidence Sheet and combined pupil pack carry all six exact weekly outcomes as a tick-and-comment grid. The Weekly Plan Row explicitly says assessing week.
evidence_rule: Actual pupil choices, work, support, dates and comments only. Adult models, photo descriptions and simulations are labelled honestly. Missing work or unperformed practical actions stay visible. A tick records weekly evidence, not award completion.
